name: What is the process for getting my sliding door rollers replaced by City Dweller, LLC in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting my sliding door rollers replaced by City Dweller, LLC in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process typically begins with a free consultation where we assess your sliding door's condition and identify the roller issues. We then provide a detailed, transparent quote for the replacement service. Once approved, our experienced technicians will schedule a convenient time for the repair. We handle everything from carefully removing the door, replacing the old rollers with high-quality new ones, to cleaning the tracks and re-installing the door, ensuring smooth operation. We serve Bay Area, Pacifica, Daly City, San Bruno, and South San Francisco.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, detailed quote, scheduled replacement by technicians, and thorough re-installation, serving the Bay Area.
